title: Read every file a story changed in Intent

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-420#open-review-in-intent at 5a98723474a8a3fb83e1d3263ec06d5afd849040 (branch claude/read-every-file-a-story-changed-in-intent; plan 759, slice 2 "Decision at slice 2 start" read)

Verdict: Caught (bounded to a Done story whose worktree is retained and readable). The maintained e2e check e2e/intent/intent-done-retained-workspace.spec.ts, case "a readable Done workspace cannot replace published locations, inventory, unchanged source or original diffs", caught the fault at line 109: `expect(answer).toMatchObject({ kind: "published", completion })`. Under the fault it received `kind: "snapshot"`.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise on the retained-workspace path. Optional: dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-story-outside-locations.spec.ts's Done case passed under the fault, because its stubbed review endpoint ignores the `historical` query. If the caller wants this frontend case to protect the published-completion choice by itself, its fixture would need to answer only the historical read. That is a strengthening option, not a gap the probe found, because the e2e catches the fault.

Promise checked: "A Done story whose worktree is retired lists every file of its published completion, production code included", together with "The comparison is the story's default one, as Intent reads it today". So a Done story's Changes reads its published completion, not a workspace snapshot or landed run. The suggestion was validated. The deleted intent-done-review-modes.spec.ts was about the Intent-opened Side panel review, which slice 2 removed with its control. What still matters from it is that Done Intent's own read picks the published completion, and that is the target probed here.

Fault: dashboard/src/useStoryComparison.ts, in the useDefaultStoryReview call: `historical: completed,` changed to `historical: false,`. With `completed: true` and no `historical`, the server (dashboard/server/storyReviewRecordAdmission.ts admittedIdentityReview) answers with the readable workspace snapshot, or with the landed run when no workspace is readable, instead of the published completion. Fixtures and assertions were left as they were.

Independent wrong-behavior observation: a scratch e2e witness (temporary copy of the maintained case's setup, without its assertions) ran under the fault and saw these on the Done story's Intent:
- the review answer kind was "snapshot";
- the header said "Compared … with worktree at …, uncommitted changes included.";
- Changes showed "The story's historical Intent locations and test source are unavailable: its landed result could not be established." and listed no files of the published completion.
So the promised Changes listing of the published completion went wrong on the intended path. The witness file was deleted afterwards.

Runs (scratch worktree of 5a98723, npm ci; proof records used to confirm tests actually ran):
- Baseline: e2e intent-done-retained-workspace.spec.ts 2/2 passed. Frontend intent-story-outside-locations.spec.ts plus intent-done-source-selection.spec.ts 5/5 passed.
- Fault: e2e failed 1/2 (the case above failed at line 109; "unrecoverable history…" passed). Frontend: intent-done-source-selection "a newly selected Done story shows only its own historical source…" timed out waiting to click dashboard/tests/a.spec.ts inside .intent-locations. Its page snapshot showed a.spec.ts listed outside the locations, so it is a secondary, helper-level catch. The 4 intent-story-outside-locations cases, including "a Done story lists its published completion's product code outside the locations", passed. That check does not exercise the wrong path.
- Restored: the edit was reverted by an EXIT trap and the witness was removed. git diff was empty and no untracked files remained apart from test-results. Reran the same commands: e2e 2/2 passed and frontend 5/5 passed.
- The scratch worktree was then removed with git worktree remove --force. The live execution worktree was untouched (status clean).

Prior disposition recognized: slice 2's decision to delete the Intent-opened review specs is consistent with this result. The Done Intent published-completion read is still guarded by the retained e2e case. This probe makes no new repair decision.

Cost:
- Test runtime: about 96 s measured, the sum of per-test durationMs from the seven proof records (e2e baseline/fault/restored 6.7/4.7/7.6 s; frontend baseline/fault/restored 6.5/33.6/6.4 s; witness 30.2 s, mostly 30 s timeouts). This excludes runner startup and one early e2e baseline run without a proof record (about 12 s wall, measured by the shell).
- Human effort: unavailable; this run was delegated with no human interaction to measure.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separately supported measure. There is no token or tool-time meter available to this agent; roughly 25 tool calls (count, estimated).


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 254325 ms (measured), from 1795280912000 to 1795281166325 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


Wrap-up disposition: checked 5a98723474a8a3fb83e1d3263ec06d5afd849040, Caught, no follow-up.
